as_told.title: Rocket over the Triangle swerves as a UFO appears

plain: During a rocket launch at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports, an unidentified aerial phenomenon (an unknown object in the sky) is said to have appeared over an area called the triangle. Within minutes a Blackhawk military helicopter came over the mesa, dropped down over the property and hovered above the south field. Brandon Fugal tells this as someone who was there. He says it was one of many times they had launched rockets. Michels tells a different moment from his own visit in 2022: a rocket swerved hard to the west, as if it were avoiding something, though there was no wind to push it. He says nothing of a helicopter. Both stories hint that something unseen is in the air over the ranch, and in Fugal's version the military is watching it.
